triples.tail_surface: valve actuator gearbox on a sea water isolating valve in the ballast system was defective
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压载系统海水隔离阀执行器齿轮箱缺陷
triples.evidence_text: The MAIB investigation established that the valve actuator gearbox on a sea water isolating valve in the ballast system was defective such that someone operating the valve might believe the valve was shut when it was not. The valve position indicator was working but it had not been checked prior to work being started on the ballast pump. When the pump was removed the engine room flooded through the 15cm diameter ballast main.

triples.tail_surface: water began to enter the space
triples.evidence_text: A ballast pump in the vessel’s engine room was being maintained, when water began to enter the space.
The valve position indicator was working but it had not been checked prior to work being started on the ballast pump.

triples.head_surface: actuator mechanism of ship's side valves
triples.evidence_text: propose to the International Association of Classification Societies that its requirements should be amended to include a function test of the actuator mechanism of ship's side valves during special surveys
